blocks.text: Condo buildings in City of Maple Ridge
Rosewood Court — 22611 116 Avenue

Built 1991, 81 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records restrictions as: age restrictions, pets allowed with restrictions, rentals not allowed — the rental line is void since November 24, 2022. Listings describe a 55+ retirement community in Fraserview Village.
Emerald Manor — 11609 227 Street

Built 1997 per current listings, an accessible 55+ retirement community in Fraserview Village; gas and hot water included in the strata fee per listings. Unit count: Not confirmed. Restrictions beyond the published 55+ positioning: Not confirmed.
The Willows — 11578 225 Street
Built 1987 per current listings, marketed "for those 55 and better" in Fraserview Village; listings describe it as pet friendly (two cats or two dogs, or one of each). Unit count: Not confirmed.
Castlemount — 11601 227 Street
Listings name it "Castlemount at Fraserview Village," a 55+ community with access to the village clubhouse, exercise facilities, indoor pool and workshop. Year built and unit count: Not confirmed.
Riverside — 11510 225 Street
Built 1988 and described as a 55+ community in a current listing. Unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Podium — 11655 Fraser Street

Built 2024, 125 units (building directory, secondary source). The presale record describes a 6-storey wood-frame project by Whitetail Homes made up of 120 condos plus 5 townhomes — the directory's 125 appears to count both forms; the townhomes are not separate apartment condos. Restrictions: Not confirmed.
Brickwater Village (Brickwater at The Village) — 227 Street / Selkirk Avenue area, by Falcon Homes

A mixed-use project of four buildings, four storeys of homes over ground-floor commercial, with "200+ condominiums" project-wide (presale source, secondary); individual building addresses and years from current listings: 22633 Selkirk Avenue (built 2024), 11865 227 Street (built 2022), 11893 227 Street (built 2019), 22638 119 Avenue (built 2020). Restrictions: Not confirmed generally.
Highpointe (also spelled "Highpoint" in some listings) — 11641 227 Street
Built 2024; a building-directory listing page records strata plan EPS9270 and the unit as one of 35 units at the address (secondary source). Restrictions: Not confirmed.
Station One — 12070 227 Street
Named in current East Central apartment listings. Year built, unit count and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Sierra Ridge — 11703 Fraser Street
Unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Falcon Manor — 22150 Dewdney Trunk Road
Built 2007, 58 units, by Falcon Homes (current listings); wood-frame construction, underground parking. Age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Era (Era One) — 22265 Dewdney Trunk Road and 22226 Brown Avenue

First phase of the Era master-planned community by Johnston Meier Insurance and SwissReal Developments; current listings record units as built in 2022. Unit counts conflict between sources (143 vs 192 condos in Phase 1 accounts) — every Phase 1 count is not confirmed until the strata plan for the specific building is read. The phase's 49 rental apartments are non-market rental stock, not strata condos (see Tenure traps). Published restrictions for the strata buildings: Not confirmed.
The 222 — 12320 222 Street
A building-directory listing headline records a 62-unit wood-frame development, pets allowed (directory/listing-level data). Year built and age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Canuck Plaza — 12096 222 Street
Named in current West Central apartment listings. Any "25+" age label attached to this building is void: the only lawful strata age bylaw in BC is 55+, so a 25+ line cannot bind a buyer.
Southridge Terrace — 22230 North Avenue
Named in current West Central apartment listings. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Wildwood Terrace — 12170 222 Street
A listing aggregator records the complex name as Wildwood Terrace and the property sub-type as Apartment/Condo. Year built, unit count and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Emerson (The Emerson) — 22315 122 Avenue

Built 2019 per current listings; a building-directory listing headline records a 69-unit concrete development, pets allowed (directory/listing-level data), while one listing records frame-wood/mixed construction — construction is not confirmed until the Form B is read. Age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Inspire — 12109, 12133 and 12143 223 Street

By Platinum Group of Companies; a developer/realtor information sheet records Building 3 at 83 homes with an estimated completion of January 2027 — part of this project is presale product (REDMA) — and listings variously record units as built in 2025 and 2026, so the build year per building is not confirmed until the strata plan is read. Total project unit count: Not confirmed.
Magnolia Gate — 22255 122 Avenue
Named in current West Central apartment listings, which describe underground parking. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
223 North — 22318 Lougheed Highway
Named in current West Central apartment listings. Year built, unit count, construction and restrictions: Not confirmed.
Westbrooke — 12020 207A Street

Listings classify units as Apartment/Condo with Freehold Strata title; a pet-friendly building with a rentable guest suite, elevator, underground parking, and gas and hot water included in the strata fee per listings. Build-year conflict: listings give 2004 and 2005 — the exact year is not confirmed. Unit count: Not confirmed.

items.t: The city as the page bounds it, in its own words: the Fraser River to the south, the Golden Ears range and Golden Ears Provincial Park to the north, Pitt Meadows to the west and Mission to the east. Street-level board boundaries: Not verified — the board publishes no street-level boundary for the Maple Ridge sub-areas, and no City planning-area boundary was substituted for one.

Board geography: Maple Ridge is a Greater Vancouver REALTORS® (GVR) board community — one of the 14 communities SnapStats covers — with 12 board sub-areas: Albion, Cottonwood, East Central, North, Northeast, Northwest, Silver Valley, Southwest, Thornhill, Websters Corners, West Central and Whonnock.
SnapStats publishes medians at community level only; sub-area medians are not verified. The 12 board sub-area rows sum exactly to the community totals in both splits.
The verified named buildings sit in those two sub-areas plus one building in Northwest Maple Ridge.

Attached inventory elsewhere, September 2026 (inventory / solds): Albion 18 / 4; Cottonwood 34 / 4; Northwest 5 / 1; Silver Valley 15 / 0; Southwest 8 / 3; Thornhill 8 / 0; North, Northeast, Websters Corners and Whonnock 0 / 0. Attached listings on a board row are inventory, not verified named buildings — several of those sub-areas hold townhouse stock only.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in City of Maple Ridge

items.t: North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan: the Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw was adopted June 23, 2026 (City announcement June 24, 2026), formalizing an approximately 500-acre economic hub in northeast Maple Ridge; the plan establishes future land use designations only and approves no construction or development projects itself.

SSMUH and housing need: based on the City's interim Housing Needs Report, Maple Ridge will need 27,778 new homes by 2041, and the fall 2025 OCP and area-plan updates include new provisions for small-scale multi-unit housing (3 to 6 units on single-detached lots) and increased density around transit hubs. SSMUH product is generally not strata condo product.

blocks.text: Good to know about City of Maple Ridge

items.t: The OCP number itself is contested. Zoning Bylaw 7600-2019, by contrast, is the settled zoning citation.
A buyer filtering "condos" in those sub-areas is mostly looking at townhouses wearing a combined board label.

Fraserview Village is a shared-amenity cluster, not four separate worlds. Rosewood Court, Emerald Manor, The Willows, Castlemount and Riverside sit in one 55+ village whose buildings share a village amenity building (indoor pool, hot tub, exercise room/clubhouse, guest suite) described consistently across listings — strata-fee comparisons inside the village have to account for that shared facility.

One project, two tenures, on Dewdney Trunk Road. Era's first phase mixes strata condos with 49 non-market rental apartments in the same phase — a unit's building and tenure, not just its address, decide whether it is a purchasable strata lot at all.

The next OCP cycle is already scheduled. A more comprehensive OCP review, with broad community engagement, is planned following the release of the 2026 Census data and a new Housing Needs Report in 2028, leading up to 2030 — today's plan permissions are a 2025-alignment snapshot, not the final word.

Planning frame: updates to the City's Official Community Plan and the Hammond, Silver Valley and Town Centre area plans were adopted by Council in November 2025 (the November 25, 2025 Regular Council Meeting) and updates to the Albion Area Plan in October 2025 (October 28, 2025), to meet the Province's December 31, 2025 deadline for local plans to align with provincial housing targets; the Silver Valley Area Plan is read as Section 10.3 of the Official Community Plan.

items.t: Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan: adopted Jan 27, 2026 per the City record: (corridor ends at 221 St) — carried as adopted here.

SSMUH / housing frame, as the City states it: based on the City's interim Housing Needs Report, Maple Ridge will need 27,778 new homes by 2041, and the fall 2025 OCP and area-plan updates include new provisions for small-scale multi-unit housing (3 to 6 units on single-detached lots) and increased density around transit hubs — so a single-detached lot's multiplex potential runs through the adopted plan and Zoning Bylaw 7600-2019, not a listing summary.

Next OCP cycle: a more comprehensive OCP review and update, with broad community engagement, is planned following the release of the 2026 Census data and the completion of a new Housing Needs Report in 2028, with the full review leading up to 2030.

ALR rules (carried for any parcel where reserve status is confirmed on the ALC maps — no parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

items.t: The usual duplex form: The City's fall 2025 OCP and area-plan updates include new provisions for small-scale multi-unit housing (3 to 6 units on single-detached lots) and increased density around transit hubs, on the City's interim Housing Needs Report figure of 27,778 new homes needed by 2041.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in City of Maple Ridge

items.t: Suites inside a duplex (Maple Ridge): The secondary-suite cap is 40% of gross floor area outside the Floodplain Area — Maple Ridge's own rule, never borrowed.

SSMUH position (Maple Ridge): Duplexes are the baseline form under the provincial SSMUH framework; the City's fall 2025 updates carry SSMUH provisions of 3 to 6 units on single-detached lots with added density around transit hubs.
